question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

CROOKED
solution:
The correct answer is **‘straight’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given word ‘crooked’ means bent or twisted.(टेढा मुडा हुआ)
 
• Example: The village had narrow crooked roads.
 
 
• Let’s see the meaning of other options.
 
 
• **‘Straight’** means linear and direct.
 
 
• Example- The chief road of the city leads straight to the temple.(सीधा)
 
 
 
• **‘Curved’** means bent or twisted.
 
 
• Example- The child could not draw proper curved lines as instructed by her teacher.(मुड़ा हुआ)
 
 
 
• **‘Hooked’** means curved or ‘hook-shaped’.
 
 
• Example- The plastic pots carrying beautiful plants were hooked to the window grills.(हुकनुमा)
 
 
 
• **‘Bent’** means twisted.
 
 
• Example- The girl bent down in front of her grandmother to seek her blessings.(झुका हुआ)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence according to the meanings of the given words, the correct option is Option 1 i.e. straight.
